title: FedDAC: Federated Learning with Distribution Anonymization through Clustering on non-IID data - code, trained models and experiment logs
description: Source code, experiment grid, raw per-run results (JSON), trained global models and aggregated tables/figures for the revised FedDAC manuscript. Includes FedDAC, FedAvg, FedProx, PP-CFL, FedSe and FedSeq re-implementations, component ablations, record-level DP-SGD with RDP accounting, and label-distribution/membership inference attacks on MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and Tiny-ImageNet.
